title: Conditional κ = 0.00312360607355 (+0.00000024550355 over #5802)
body:
[PR5806](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5806) defined this source composition and proved a conservative conditional bound, but did not emit or replay the hybrid. This PR supplies the actual word, a source-bound constructor, complete scientific checks and strict pricing. Conditional **κ = 0.00312360607355**, an increase of **0.00000024550355 over PR5802**. The selected frontier is unchanged.

The complete word has 25,982 instructions, 770 public inputs, 28 owned labels, 30 owned lifetimes and peak 13 live owned fields. The full p16/a7 caller has **13,444 productive targets, 66,906 paid calls and rank surplus 760**. Both blocks, all three pending sums, every native map, helper matcher, COPY/CLEAR, scalar and route allowance are included. No owned field is credited as productive.

The raw crossing is strictly inside `(0.00312360607454,0.00312360607455)`. The claim is the largest 1e-14 grid point with the fixed 1e-12 reserve and a one-grid-step kappa-to-tested gap. A negative derivative bound and rejection of the next point certify that scoped parameter optimum. The paid profile has changed; this is not extra digits of an unchanged source bill.

[Constructor](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/049714cf00952f58d2f48ef596445f5f08590ff8/research/p104-materialized-shared-hybrid/construct.py), [proof](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/049714cf00952f58d2f48ef596445f5f08590ff8/research/p104-materialized-shared-hybrid/PROOF.md), [complete receipt](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/049714cf00952f58d2f48ef596445f5f08590ff8/research/p104-materialized-shared-hybrid/RESULT.json), [source pins](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/049714cf00952f58d2f48ef596445f5f08590ff8/research/p104-materialized-shared-hybrid/SOURCES.json).

Verification covers all 798 input axes, 636,804 endpoint coefficients, a separate dense transpose, 2,924 distinct native maps with absolute phases, 1,124 helper normalizers, 208 main adapters, the complete physical caller, two exact interval engines, all three compiler tails, finite completion, 54 strict outer rows and four functional checks. Eight actual word/source/caller/invoice controls, the native phase control and old parameter controls reject. Five final frozen-input corruptions and two decoded-word binding corruptions reject before mathematics runs.

Primary and registered normal/optimized replays passed. The final compact package replaces two duplicate paper-word files with their exact existing archive members and decoded-hash bindings; it emits the same checked word and receipt. Its complete sealed `-I -O -B` replay passed in **254.767 seconds**, with empty PATH, no Git and read-only payloads. All 23 exported files including the export receipt retained bytes and modes. Export SHA256 `c88fc8d7755e3a55b19522e03054c4225b77452f2b6a1d842bb5b0fe52808281`. Final metadata, committed-byte and export-integrity checks pass. Hosted scientific replay and independent acceptance are pending.

Reproduce: `python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-materialized-shared-hybrid`.

The five assumptions remain: native_all_columns, owned_erasure, compiler, precision_tape and analytic_recovery. The fixed hybrid is materialized; the enormous uniform compiler word and rounded multiplier are not. No global construction optimum or complete formal theorem is claimed. No merge, closure or frontier update is requested.

[Canonical claim and evidence](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/5804#discussioncomment-19205623). Credit Dugongue/PR5806 for the composition and informal proof; Ali Romman's PR5802/5786/5774 parent constructions; Joel Pulikkan/GamingPuzzled for R22; the PR5796 second block; flyingviper; Cinna Davis, David Arias, Gareth Davidson, Cao Yifan, zxv, Jacob Alan Sussman and all retained native/controller/compiler/BIT/analytic contributors. Full parent notices are retained. New materialization and verification: Ali Romman with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; no subagents. Apache-2.0.
